content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user who manages my tasks","i_want":"to update the details of an existing task","so_that":"my task list stays accurate when plans change","business_description":"Users can change the fields of a task they already created, using the same form used to create a task. The form opens with the stored values. A save is accepted only when the title is non-empty and the due date is not earlier than the creation date. The user sees a success or error message after every save, and the stored task is never changed when the save fails.","business_value":"Users can correct and maintain their tasks without deleting and recreating them, which keeps the task list and reports accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user changes the title to a non-empty value and clicks save","then":"The backend stores the new title, the saved title is shown, and a success message is displayed"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user clears the title field and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the title is required, and the stored title is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task with a creation date of 1 March","when":"The user sets the due date to 28 February and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the due date cannot be earlier than the creation date, and the stored due date is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form and the backend returns an error for the save request","when":"The user clicks save","then":"The stored task keeps its previous values, an error message is displayed, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task that no longer exists is open in the edit form","when":"The user saves changes to it","then":"The backend responds with a task not found error, the form shows an error message, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A save request that sends a field value the backend does not accept","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error, stores no changes, and returns the error to the frontend"},{"given":"An update request that omits the title","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and stores no changes"},{"given":"A save request that fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"The backend returns the error","then":"The backend stores no partial changes and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"A task with stored values exists","when":"The user opens it for editing","then":"The edit form shows the stored values of that task"},{"given":"The request to load a task by ID fails, for example because the task does not exist or the server returns an error","when":"The user opens the task for editing","then":"An error message is shown, the form shows no prefilled values, and no success message is displayed"}],"edge_cases":["A title that contains only spaces: the PRD requires a non-empty title but does not say whether spaces-only counts as empty. This is an open question.","A due date equal to the creation date: the PRD rejects only due dates earlier than the creation date, so an equal date is expected to be accepted.","Changing only the title while the due date is already earlier than the creation date is not possible in stored data, because the stored task must already pass the rule. The PRD does not say how older records that break the rule are handled. This is an open question.","Whether the creation date can be edited is not stated in the PRD. The edit form is assumed not to change it; this is an open question.","Two users or two browser tabs saving the same task: the PRD does not define conflict handling.
